name: claim_default_period
xsql:
SELECT Nvl(MAX(p.name), '') AS period_name
FROM   xactly.xc_period p
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_period_type pt
    ON  p.period_type_id_fk = pt.period_type_id
    AND pt.name             = 'MONTHLY'
WHERE  p.end_date < CurDate()
  AND  p.name NOT IN ('SOT', 'EOT')
  AND  p.start_date = ( SELECT MAX(p2.start_date)
                        FROM   xactly.xc_period p2
                        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_period_type pt2
                            ON  p2.period_type_id_fk = pt2.period_type_id
                            AND pt2.name             = 'MONTHLY'
                        WHERE  p2.end_date < CurDate()
                          AND  p2.name NOT IN ('SOT', 'EOT') )
